Card Q&A.a: No,  effects are "trash this card in your battle area to activate" effects, therefore you can choose to not trash the card in order to prevent them from activating.

Card Q&A.a:
No, it doesn't. [Marcus Damon] is played as a Tamer by [BT13-020 ShineGreymon: Burst Mode] effect and then it's treated as being a Digimon by an effect, therefore it isn't considered to be played as a Digimon.

Does this card's  also activate when one of my effects plays an opponent's Digimon?

Card Q&A.a:
Yes, you can. When the opponent's Digimon is played by an effect, this card's  effect and BT15-081 [Leviamon (X Antibody)]'s {Trash} [All Turns] effect will trigger simultaneously. You activate this card's  effect first and play EX5-063 [Leviamon] from the trash. EX5-063 [Leviamon]'s effect derived triggers, then BT15-081 [Leviamon (X Antibody)]'s triggered {Trash} [All Turns] effect can digivolve EX5-063 [Leviamon] into BT15-081 [Leviamon (X Antibody)].
